pr.title: feat(dcp): DCP core provenance contracts + control-snapshot envelope (TP-DCP-0001)
pr.body: First DCP build packet, contract-locking only (read-only, net-new files). Locks the provenance-safe .v0 contract floor from the GPT-5.5 synthesis REV1 (Opus-audited GO_WITH_FIXES, delta-rechecked): dcp_red_lane_taxonomy (incl. the DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001 invariant), dcp_control_snapshot (envelope-only), and PROVISIONAL .v0 envelopes for dcp_proof_pointer / dcp_evidence_hit / dcp_chronicle_receipt / dcp_helper_receipt + a §6.0 provenance meta-contract. No live adapters/writes; DCP_MUTATION_CLASS/APPROVAL_ARTIFACT/PROJECT_RESOURCE_MAP deferred. Every contract+field provenance-tagged (REPO_VALIDATED/EXTERNAL_PROPOSED/SYNTHESIS_INVENTED); acceptance verifies provenance coverage, not just fixture round-trip; auditor != implementer. Evidence campaign + synthesis + audit trail in artifacts/dcp (dcp/evidence-campaign branch).

Each schema embeds a provenance block (tag + source_ref) and validation block (state). External (DR-016) / synthesis-invented shapes carry validation_state=PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT.
